descriptionAboutYou: Senior Software Engineer with 3+ years of Experience, currently working at LoanDna. Specialized in building scalable, high-performance applications across Full Stack and Mobile development. Proficient in Frontend, Backend, Database design, and System architecture, with a strong focus on delivering efficient and maintainable solutions. Hands-on experience with Cloud and Container technologies including Amazon Web Services, Docker with Swarm, and Kubernetes. Adept to designing Microservices, Event Driven, Monolith Architectural Practices. Optimizing Performance, Scalability and Availability Tradeoffs in a System. Managing end-to-end development lifecycles. Passionate about solving complex problems, improving system reliability, and continuously learning modern technologies to build robust and scalable systems.

domains.FrontEnd Development: Engineered high-performance, scalable web applications with responsive user interfaces using React.js and Next.js. Leveraged Redux and MobX for efficient state management in complex, data-intensive applications. Designed and implemented micro-frontend architecture using Module Federation to enable independently deployable UI services and improve scalability. Built robust and intuitive UI components using Material UI and Tailwind CSS, and managed complex forms with Formik. Optimized performance and SEO using Next.js features such as Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG). Utilized AG Grid for efficient large-scale data handling, integrated React Graphs for visualization, and implemented PDF.js for dynamic document rendering, enhancing overall user experience and performance.

domains.Mobile Application Development: Developed high-performance mobile applications using React Native. Leveraged Expo for streamlined development and deployment. Focused on responsive UI, performance optimization, and seamless cross-platform user experience.

domains.BackEnd Development: Engineered robust, scalable, high-performance, and secure server-side applications using .NET Core, Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, and Java with Spring Boot. Designed and developed microservices and RESTful APIs with a focus on reliability and maintainability. Implemented real-time communication using WebSockets and WebRTC, enabling low-latency, event-driven systems. Leveraged Redis for caching and performance optimization, and utilized Prisma ORM for efficient database access and schema management. Built flexible and efficient APIs using GraphQL, improving data fetching and client performance. Strong emphasis on system design, scalability, and backend performance optimization.

domains.DataBase: Experienced in SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, and Firebase with strong expertise in database design, ACID compliance, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning. Skilled in using stored procedures, triggers, and views for scalable applications.

domains.Cloud: Experienced in deploying and managing scalable, cloud-native applications using Amazon Web Services (AWS), including S3, EC2, and CloudFront. Proficient in application hosting and deployment using IIS Server. Implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to automate build, test, and deployment workflows. Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker (Swarm) and Kubernetes for efficient resource management and high availability. Strong focus on reliability, scalability, and streamlined deployment processes in cloud environments.

domains.CRM Integrations: I have Experience in Integrating the Web Application with CRM's like Zoho, Salesforce, Zendesk, Freshdesk and Freshsales using their Respective Api's.

experiences: Designed and developed an AI driven Property Analysis System and a Dynamic Rule Engine along with an Intelli view Application called CAQore. The document of the property will be Uploaded and the information’s required for analysis are extracted with the help of Cortex AI and stored in Snowflake (Data warehouse).

A Rule Engine developed using Dot Net Core pulls the new property information’s periodically and the information is passed to rule sets and for each rule decision is made whether it is passed or failed or needs manual check.

After all new property runs against the rule engine and the respective results and is stored in SQL Server. And an Intelli view Application called CAQore is used by the Analyst persons to check the results, and they can confirm it as the property related pdf can also be viewed and Traceability for each Rule is also mapped against the PDF and can change the decisions also. After all rules are passed the Property is confirmed for Sale. If any fails, the Analyst will change status to corrections required and the whole process starts again after changed document is submitted.
